The '''Novolek Beacon''' was a [[Neutron star/Legends|pulsar]] star located in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] between [[Nwarcol Point]], [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] and [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It was a trans-dimensional energy streamer, sending out pulses of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], heat and matter. [[Gravity/Legends|Gravitational]], multidimensional, curves passed through the [[Star/Legends|star]], creating a massive [[Mass shadow/Legends|hyperspace shadow]]. The star did not have the mass to cause a collapse into a [[Black hole/Legends|singularity]]. A strange phenomenon called the [[Ei'shuun Aa Effect]] caused fragments of stellar plasma to break off from the Beacon, dragging disproportionate hyperspace shadows, at unpredictable intervals. Further, [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] itself was distorted. To the protected natural [[Eye/Legends|eye]], however, the star was merely a typical particle fountain. Every 28 days, 12 hours and 42 minutes the star flared, though the flare itself might have lasted a few minutes up to as much as two days.

The Beacon was discovered by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] when they first explored this region of space, before the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], in approximately [[25,100 BBY]]. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Hutts had attempted numerous unsuccessful schemes to destroy the pulsar. The star had been blamed for numerous transport delays and lost [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] cargoes by their employees. Moreover, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] could hide in the Novolek system, knowing that their prey could not signal for assistance.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] the most recent attempt was being researched by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at the behest of [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the Hutt. [[Mal Biron]], an operative of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], placed a [[Communications satellite|comsat]] at the Beacon around the same time as the end point of a race designed to determine the most skilled potential operatives for his boss, [[Sprax]]. Among the competitors were [[Nabrun Leids/Legends|Nabrun Leids]], [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot]], [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]], [[Rycar Ryjerd/Legends|Rycar Ryjerd]] and the pirate [[Morturr Heth]], masquerading as [[Az-Iban]].
